execution_message.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: KCK-03B2 individual model-sheet candidate, NOT animation or production. Input image 1 is the ONLY approved identity and rendering reference. Keep the exact Soft Handmade 2.5D illustrator treatment: dark warm brown hand outline, controlled fine paper/pencil grain, flat base colors with gentle volume, soft upper-left light. One isolated whole-body character only, genuine transparent background; no text, labels, panels, duplicates, floor, cast shadow, white matte or new props. Square canvas; entire ears, tail, feet and required prop inside a generous transparent margin on all sides. Keep approximately the same character mass/size and proportions across sheets; do not enlarge the head or shrink limbs. Eyes keep reference anatomy: large primary white glint in the UPPER LEFT of each visible open eye, small secondary glint LOWER RIGHT. Light direction is SCREEN upper left regardless of body rotation. Do not mirror the reference or transfer props between anatomical hands. This is one still PNG, no collage. Subject: approved mint Dinosaur dinosaur-01 from corrected A3. Same large head and short rounded body; deep warm brown round eyes with no iris/white sclera, peach cheeks, little w-shaped smile, cream belly with EXACTLY TWO separate curved brown lines, soft yellow rounded dorsal spikes from head down back to long tail, two short feet with toe marks. Magnifying glass with yellow-orange handle/frame and pale blue lens stays held by DINOSAUR'S LEFT hand (viewer right in front view); other hand near chest. Keep all identity colors and head/body proportion. Open-eye primary highlight centroid approximately x=0.35,y=0.28 within each eye's bounding box, secondary smaller below/right; do not put primary glint on right. Expression view: same near-front three-quarter full-body reference pose, camera, proportions and props. Change only the FACE to clearly happy: open cheerful smile with tongue for Cat, slightly open cheerful smile for Dinosaur; keep both EYES OPEN with original anatomy, correct upper-left primary/lower-right secondary glints. No closed eyes, jumps, extra teeth, props or pose change.
